$comment: Card-data sources for the engine. The primary database has a REST and GraphQL API without a key and SDKs for several languages; confirm coverage through the newest set before relying on any source. Card text and images remain the rights holders' property.

primary.name: TCGdex
primary.license: open-source database; card content belongs to the rights holders

alternatives.name: pokemon-tcg-pocket-database
alternatives.format: JSON cards and sets; also on npm

alternatives.name: pokemon-tcg-pocket-cards (PocketDecks)
alternatives.license: v5 files AGPL-3.0-or-later; v1-v4 MIT; check freshness

alternatives.name: pokeclaude CSV
alternatives.format: CSV; also an MCP server on npm as pokeclaude
alternatives.warning: deck-advice data, not engine-grade; see the Warning section in card-data.md

referenceSites.name: Limitless TCG Pocket
referenceSites.use: every set and promo, decklists, card text checks

referenceSites.name: Bulbapedia
referenceSites.use: rulings, per-set offering rates, set pages
